item.title: Maharashtra sets up task force to study digital addiction among children; report by next session
item.description: The task force, which will include members from both the Houses of the state legislature, will submit its report before the next session of the legislature.

item.title: UP DElEd result 2026 out at btcresult.in; over 2.42 lakh qualify
item.description: UP DElEd result 2026: A total of 2.42 lakh (2,42,306) candidates successfully cleared the exams. Check UP DElEd result at btcresult.in.

item.title: Rs 35,000 loan British Raj never repaid, Indian family wants it back after 109 years
item.description: Vivek Ruthia, the grandson of Dada Jumma Lal, is pursuing the case to assert this entitlement. The matter goes far beyond financial compensation and represents a significant historical claim. If the legal challenge succeeds, it could become one of the biggest monetary cases ever seen in India.

item.title: How Israel's Iron Dome could be a game changer for India's 'Mission Sudarshan Chakra' | EXPLAINED
item.description: It is expected that during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to Israel, New Delhi and Tel Aviv may sign multiple pacts, especially focusing on the defence sector. The two sides may also sign a deal for procurement of Iron Dome system.

item.title: NCERT judiciary chapter row: Supreme Court says heads must role, refuses to accept Centre's apology
item.description: NCERT book row: The Centre has informed the Supreme Court today that people who are involved in drafting chapters on 'judiciary corruption' will not work with UGC or any ministry.

item.title: Eknath Shinde, Shiv Sena to stop using VRS Ventures aircraft after Ajit Pawar plane crash: Sources
item.description: The decision comes nearly a month after VSR Ventures, a charter flight operator whose Learjet 45 crashed in Maharashtra's Baramati on January 28, killing the then Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Ajit Pawar and four others.

item.title: Judiciary chapter row: SC bans controversial book, issues notices to Centre and NCERT chief
item.description: NCERT Judiciary chapter row: The court has issued show cause notice to secretary, department of school education, NCERT director Dinesh Prasad Saklani.

item.title: Exclusive: Rashmika Mandanna, Vijay Deverakonda are now officially married; Kodavu wedding at 4pm
item.description: Rashmika Mandanna and Vijay Deverakonda got married in a traditional Andhra ceremony. The couple officially tied the knot, marking a new chapter in their relationship. Their Kodavu wedding will take place later in the evening.

item.title: Veer Savarkar death anniversary: Do you know how many languages he could speak and write?
item.description: Veer Savarkar death anniversary: Savarkar stood as a linguistic powerhouse, commanding fluency in 10-14 tongues such as Marathi (his native language), Hindi, English, Sanskrit, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Persian, Urdu, plus working knowledge of Russian and Latin.

item.title: India's probable XI vs Zimbabwe: Sanju Samson IN, Rinku Singh OUT; What about Tilak Varma?
item.description: India are set for multiple changes vs Zimbabwe after the defeat to South Africa. Sanju Samson is likely to return, while Rinku Singh may sit out. Axar Patel is expected back, replacing Washington Sundar. On the other hand, Sikandar Raza has been declared fit for the clash.
